rule.comment: In the default schema map, urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:ilm:static:1.0:User:DirXML-ADAliasName in the ILM Vault maps to LoginName in SharePoint. However, on the publisher channel we don't want to set urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:ilm:static:1.0:User:DirXML-ADAliasName (presumably the AD driver will do that) and we do need a value for CN. Therefore, this rule remaps urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:ilm:static:1.0:User:DirXML-ADAliasName to CN for the publisher channel.
